thought.text: Lass mich Output im Log checken:

reasoning_content: It seems to exit immediately. Let me check if there's output in the background process.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Start and capture output
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & echo $!")

print("PID:", stdout.read().decode())

time.sleep(10)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /tmp/server.log | head -30")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
